A '''saber''' was a type of [[Sword/Legends|sword]] favored by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. However, many pirates wore them mainly for show, although they were fully capable of being used as weapons.<ref name="RPG" /> Sabers were a type of [[rapier]], often made of [[flexisteel]] and used in the sport of [[fencing]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
